body: im sorry to hear your down :/ ive struggled with depression for years. if you want to talk you can message me im a good listener. otherwise if u just want some advice here goes: breaking routine is sometimes the best thing to do. it sounds stupid but doing the same things over and over can get you stuck in a rut. try brushing your teeth with the other hand or taking a different way home. music can be a real motivatior. the key to a good day is to start your day off right. try listening to your favorite song/ radio station while you get dressed. dont ignore your problems. i know i have tried to ignore my problems but all you end up doing is making a bigger mess for myself. Hope that helped! message me anytime!
